records.text: Hopefully your wife isn't a reporter at Vanity Fair because she might see right through it. Patrick Brady writes, "They can preserve an office, but not a crime scene." Crime scene, yes, thank you. Lots of questions there. And that whole thing was meant to be a motive, and, "Oh, I can't believe Mac [name fragment unverified] did that." Well, Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy) did that. His home office, that's a little weird.
